targets.title: Learning by association in plants.
targets.evidence_quote: Gagliano et al. (Learning by association in plants, 2016) reported associative learning in pea plants. However, a replication of their protocol failed to demonstrate the same result, calling for further verification and study before mainstream acceptance of this paradigm-shifting phenomenon. This replication attempt used a larger sample size and fully blinded analysis.
